mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `review` (user_id, resource_id, reservation_id, rating, content, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceId}, #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT rv.id, rv.user_id, rv.resource_id, rv.reservation_id, rv.rating, rv.content, rv.create_time, rv.update_time, u.username AS username, r.name AS resource_name FROM `review` rv LEFT JOIN `user` u ON rv.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `resource` r ON rv.resource_id = r.id WHERE rv.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY rv.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
